_comment: Per-machine operator identity for chalette-dev skills. Lives INSIDE the plugin dir (chalette-dev/config/) so it actually ships with the skills that read it — at the repo root it was outside the plugin payload and never loaded, which meant the synthetic-only rule was prose with nothing behind it. THIS committed file is the contractor-safe default and must stay so (Guard 2 enforces it). Do NOT edit it locally to become M's profile — instead drop a gitignored config/operator.local.json next to it; every reading skill loads operator.json then overlays operator.local.json per-key. Only M keeps an overlay.
_comment_workspace_root: null = use the default synthetic fixture (skills/synthetic-workspace-runtime-test/fixtures/clean_workspace). Set a path ONLY if allowed_targets includes 'real'. Previously '~/cr-test-workspace', a directory that never existed on any machine.
_comment_intake_root: Queue root for capture-for-code / triage-intake (bug+idea intake pair). Folders new/ needs-input/ speced/ done/ killed/ + specs/ are created under it on first capture. Local to each operator's machine.
_comment_chalette_clone: Path to a chalette030 clone; only M has one. triage-intake pulls it when set AND the item targets the chalette plugin (INTAKE1 F4, operator-aware). null for contractors.
_comment_specs_dir: Where triage-intake writes specs. null = <intake_root>/specs/ (Eric default). M's overlay points it at his build-specs folder.
_comment_parking_doc: PARK-verdict target for triage-intake. null = <intake_root>/PARKING.md. M's overlay points it at his FUTURE_WORK.md.
_comment_allowed_targets: 'synthetic' = fixtures only. Adding 'real' lets the skills target a live workspace; that is M's profile, not a contractor's.
